title: Email URL Activity event (URL detonation + click telemetry for phishing triage)
summary: OCSF Email URL Activity events the phishing_triage playbook reads to evaluate URLs extracted from a reported message: gateway detonation verdicts, threat-intel hits on the destination, and (post-delivery) click telemetry used to identify responders for the credential-harvest branch and the simulation click-rate KPI.
sources: OCSF v1.4.0 Network Activity category — Email URL Activity class (uid 4012)
